# Getting Support

## 💬 Quick Questions
Post in [GitHub Discussions → Help Wanted](../../discussions/categories/help-wanted).
Response time: usually within 48 hours.

## 🐛 Found a Bug?
[Open a bug report](../../issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) — use the template.

## 💡 Have an Idea?
Post in [GitHub Discussions → Ideas](../../discussions/categories/ideas) before opening an issue.

## 📧 Private / Security Issues
Email: kohariaakif@gmail.com
Do NOT open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.
See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
